The contents of the report dated 07.05.2025 of the IIC Talcher Police station are extracted below:

"With reference to the subject cited above, I beg to submit that on dated 06.08.2024 informant Krupasindhu Gahan (54), S/O- Lt. Mohan Charan Gahan of village Angarua, PS- Talcher, Dist- Angul reported in writing alleging therein that, he is the proprictor of Maa Santoshi transport.
Since 2018 he had appointed one Akhila Prasad Mishra as accountant in his office.
Akhila Prasad Mishra was engaged to supervise the company work like payment of employees, labour payment and other official work.
As he was well known about computer and belongs to IT field, he had developed a data base software to run the business of the informant.

The informant entrusted him with a good faith to use his account numbers as 19305600000717 (Federal Bank), 19300200003328 (Federal Bank). 19300200001959 (Federal Bank),
19300200002544 (Federal Bank) for the purpose of distributing money to his different organizations/ Parties.
However, the alleged accused misappropriated a cash of more than one corers to his account as well as his wife's account instead of distributing money to different business holders.
When the informant came to know the fact and opposed Akhil Kumar Mishra, threatened him to kill in life.
Hence the informant reported the matter at PS for taking legal action.
On the written report of Informant Talcher PS case No-641, Dt- 06.08.2024, U/S- 408/506/34 IPC was registered and entrusted SI Debabrata Nayak for its investigation.

During investigation, it was ascertained that Maa Santoshi Transport has Three accounts involved in this case vide A/C No- 19305600000717, 19300200003328 and 19300200001959 of Federal Bank.
The petitioner Akhil Prasad Mishra has three bank accounts involved in this case vide A/C No-20229300267 of SBI, A/C No- 19300100047573 of Federal Bank and A/C No-50100330958999 of HDFC Bank.

Dr. Menaka Guruswamy, learned Senior Counsel submits that aggrieved by the nature and pace of investigation, an application was filed by the petitioner - complainant before the learned Magistrate with a prayer to monitor the investigation and direct the investigating officer to apprehend the absconding co-accused Tapaswini Mohapatra and to hold proper investigation by examining all the account holders who were not entitled to any amount, but had been paid money by the accused by a misutilizing his position as accountant from the account of the informant, as subsequently the said money has been credited to the accounts of the Opposite Party No.5 and wife Opposite Party No.6.

The same was disposed of on 05.10.2024 observing and directing as follows :-
"In view of the above proposition of law and considering the above facts and circumstances, nature and gravity of the offences and the stage of investigation, as huge amount of money has been misappropriated in this case, though this court cannot instruct the investigating officer on how to carry out the investigation but this court can direct to the I.O. to conduct a fair and proper investigation which is required to ascertain the exact quantum of amount of misappropriation and whether any other persons are involved along with the accused Ambika Prasad Mishra.
Consequently
, this court is inclined to partly allow the prayer made by the petitioner on the petition.
Accordingly, the I.O./I.I.C of Talcher P.S is directed to investigate the case in a fair and proper manner expeditiously without any delay in the interest of justice."

12. She submits that in the meanwhile Opposite party No 6 has been arrested and released on bail,
but as the investigation is far from satisfactory as it is still not complete and the bank accounts of the accused persons have not been frozen, the investigation may be handed over to the EOW.

She submits that in view of the modus operandi of the crime and the nature of fraud committed and the amount involved this is a fit case where investigation should be handed to EOW as it requires specialized investigation which the local police is not capable of doing.

She submits that till date the I.O. in this case has not taken steps for freezing the accounts of the accused persons to secure the Krupasindhu Gahan vs State Of Odisha on 8 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/64200950/

sentences.text: Mr. D.P. Nanda, learned Senior Counsel for the opposite parties no. 5 and 6 submits that the power of the Court to hand over investigation should not be exercised for the mere asking and should be done only in rare and exceptional cases as such an order will affect the morale of the Investigating Officer and have other adverse consequences.

He also submits that in the present case,
investigation has been partially completed and preliminary charge sheet has been submitted.
But further investigation is going on, so the prayer of the petitioner to hand over investigation to the EOW or any other authority or freeze the accounts is liable to be rejected.
He also submits that there is no prayer in the CRLMC for freezing the accounts.

He also relies on the decision in the case of K.V. Rajendran vs. The Superintendent of Police, CBCID South Zone, Chennai (Supra) as well as on the decision of the High Court of Delhi in the case of Renuka Kulkarni & Others vs. State reported in 2025 SCC OnLine Del 764.
14.

sentences.text: Perused the counter affidavit of the State filed in SLP (Crl.) No. 2685 of 2025.

In paragraph 9 it has been mentioned as follows:-
"The Investigation is not yet complete, supplementary chargesheet is yet to be filed and as per the Investigation the total amount misappropriated by the husband of Respondent Is about Rs. 2 Crore."
15.

The apprehension of the petitioner is that as the bank accounts and demat accounts of opposite parties No. 5 and 6 which contains the money fraudulently taken by them by adopting dishonest means, have not been frozen during investigation ; and as during pendency of this application,
opposite parties No.5 is likely to be released on bail and opposite party No.6 has already been released on bail, they will misutilise their freedom to withdraw the money which is lying in their bank accounts, so direction may be issued for freezing the accounts.
16.
Hearing is concluded.
But since I want to peruse the case diary, list this case on 15.05.2025 to be taken up at 2.30 p.m. for the said purpose.

17. Taking into account the nature of allegations in this case and the type of transactions which have allegedly been carried out by opposite parties no. 5 and 6 (accused), I am inclined to pass an interim order directing the I.O. for freezing the bank accounts and demat accounts of opposite parties no.5 and 6.
Necessary steps in this regard be taken by the I.O./I.I.C., Talcher Police Station promptly.
